name: SlackDailyDigestApplication
description:
**Slack Daily Digest: Keep your team informed directly in Slack**

**Integration with OpenMetadata:** This application sends a daily summary of your metadata health and changes directly to a Slack channel of your choice.

**Key Features:**
- **New Entities Summary:** Stay updated on new data assets added to your organization in the last 24 hours.
- **Data Quality Alerts:** Get a high-level summary of your data quality test results to catch issues early.
- **Scheduled Delivery:** Set up the digest to arrive at the start of your work day.

**Setup is simple:** Just provide a Slack Webhook URL and choose what information you want to include. Admins can configure the schedule using standard Cron expressions.
features: Slack Integration. Daily Reporting. Metadata Awareness.
